sh settings put global hide_error_dialogs 1
sh am broadcast -a android.intent.action.CLOSE_SYSTEM_DIALOGS >/dev/null
sh am force-stop com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox
sh am force-stop com.android.chrome
sh am force-stop com.brave.browser
stop
wait 2
launch
wait 15
taploop (?i)^(allow|ok|while using the app|only this time|not now|later|no thanks|got it|skip|continue|next)$
adclose
shot 10-relaunch
tapxy 900 892
wait 3
adclose
sh echo  | base64 -d > /data/local/tmp/findtap.sh
sh echo  | base64 -d > /data/local/tmp/anchortap.sh
sh sh /data/local/tmp/findtap.sh "Open settings"
wait 4
adclose
shot 15-settings
sh input swipe 540 1300 540 450 500
wait 1
sh input swipe 540 1300 540 450 500
wait 1
sh input swipe 540 1300 540 450 500
wait 1
shot 16-settings-premium
sh logcat -d -s DirectBilling
